signature_definitions.construction: (BUB1B - PINK1)/2 on log2(TPM + 1) expression; continuous Cox primary and median split sensitivity.
signature_definitions.rationale: RNA-seq analogue of the published two-gene differential-expression predictor; not a replication of its qRT-PCR threshold.

signature_definitions.construction: Gene-level BAP1 expression; median split for crossed grouping.
signature_definitions.rationale: Gene-expression workflow analogue of established BAP1 prognostic biology; not a mutation or immunohistochemistry classifier.

signature_definitions.construction: Gene-level PRAME expression; median split for crossed grouping.
signature_definitions.rationale: Paired with BAP1 to exercise literature-anchored four-group stratification; not a clinical PRAME assay.

signature_definitions.construction: Primary continuous Cox with expression z-scored within each cohort; parallel ordinal stage, grade and stage+grade sensitivity models.
signature_definitions.rationale: Published pan-cancer prognostic marker used to exercise FDR, family-specific adjustment and meta-analysis.
Compact Hallmark-aligned hypoxia example selected to exercise transparent multi-gene scoring without presenting a pathway model.

signature_definitions.construction: Equal-weight mean of per-gene z-scores in metastatic SKCM; crossed with the exhaustion signature after median splits.
signature_definitions.rationale: Cytotoxic T-cell and interferon-chemokine example selected for an immune-active TCGA-SKCM workflow benchmark.

signature_definitions.construction: Equal-weight mean of per-gene z-scores in metastatic SKCM; crossed with the effector signature after median splits.
signature_definitions.rationale: Checkpoint/exhaustion marker example paired with the effector score to exercise two-signature grouping and interaction Cox.

signature_definitions.construction: Primary single-gene continuous Cox with expression z-scored within each cohort; parallel ordinal stage, grade and stage+grade sensitivity models.
signature_definitions.rationale: Single-gene hypoxia and kidney-cancer marker canary selected to expose attenuation and cross-cancer heterogeneity.
